description: This file defines a React functional component named 'CategoryOption' which renders a draggable category item with interactive features such as editing, selecting, and context menu handling in a note-taking application's sidebar.

methods.name: _updateActiveCategoryId
methods.description: Dispatches action to update the active category ID in the global state.

methods.name: _updateActiveNote
methods.description: Dispatches action to update the active note, given note ID and multi-select flag.

methods.name: _updateSelectedNotes
methods.description: Dispatches action to update selected notes with given note ID and multi-select flag.

methods.name: _setCategoryEdit
methods.description: Dispatches action to set the current category into edit mode with temporary name.

methods.name: _addCategoryToNote
methods.description: Dispatches action to add a category to a note.

methods.name: _categoryDragEnter
methods.description: Dispatches action when a category is being dragged over.

methods.name: _categoryDragLeave
methods.description: Dispatches action when a category drag leaves the component area.
